abilities.name: Scarab Host
abilities.description: Using an Ability spawns a Beetle which lasts for 8 seconds, attacking nearby enemies for 20 damage. Beetle ; trait

fields.notes: Beetles spawn randomly in one of eight possible locations around Anub'arak. If Anub'arak is attacking an enemy when a Beetle is spawned, the Beetle will also attempt to attack that target. If Anub'arak is not attacking anything when a Beetle is spawned, the Beetle will attempt to find a nearby target to attack. If an enemy Hero is close enough it will be prioritized. Beetles will then attack and pursue a target found this way until that enemy dies, or the Beetles lose track of the target (through teleporting away, for example). Only then will the Beetles return to a lane.

abilities.name: Harden Carapace
abilities.description: Gain a Shield that grants 40 Spell Armor and absorbs 340 damage over 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage is dealt to shield after modifications. Spell Armor ends immediately if the shield breaks. Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Burrow Charge
abilities.description: Burrow to the target location, dealing 91 damage and briefly Stunning enemies in a small area upon surfacing, Slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds. Burrow Charge can be reactivated to surface early.; 14 / 0.5

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Slow, Stun, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Burrow Charge grants Anub'arak Unstoppable for its duration. However, like other Movement Abilities Burrow Charge cannot be cast while Rooted. Scarab Host spawns the Beetle after Anub'arak resurfaces. The stun area is a circle, flush with the back of Anub'arak's hitbox, and extending in front of him.
